Along the top, it can be counted that the table is 5 cells wide; along the left side, it can be counted that the table is 6 cells high. The upper-left corner cell gives 3, the lower-left corner cell gives 10, and the border cell on the right side near the bottom, exactly one cell above the lower-right corner, is labeled x. Reasoning: According to the specified method, number the border cells clockwise starting from the 3 in the upper-left corner as a_0, a_1, a_2, .... Because the table is 5 cells wide and 6 cells high, there are 2·5+2·(6-2)=18 border cells in total. According to the positions in the figure, the upper-left corner 3 is a_0; when going clockwise to the lower-left corner, 10 is a_13; the x one cell above the lower-right corner on the right side is a_8. The problem rule says that the number in each border cell equals the sum of the numbers in its two adjacent border cells, so a_i=a_{i-1}+a_{i+1}, which is equivalent to a_{i+1}=a_i-a_{i-1}. Let a_0=A and a_1=B, then successively there are: a_2=B-A, a_3=(B-A)-B=-A, a_4=-A-(B-A)=-B, a_5=-B-(-A)=A-B, a_6=(A-B)-(-B)=A. Thus the sequence cycles every 6 terms: A, B, B-A, -A, -B, A-B. It is known that a_0=3, so A=3. Also because 13 is congruent to 1 mod 6, a_13 has the same form as a_1, that is, a_13=B. In the figure a_13=10, therefore B=10. x is a_8, and 8 is congruent to 2 mod 6, so a_8=a_2=B-A=10-3=7.

method.method_draft: Label the border cells in clockwise order starting with the top-left cell containing 3 as a_0. From the image, the table border is 5 cells wide and 6 cells tall; the bottom-left 10 is a_13 in clockwise order, and the cell x on the right side one cell above the bottom-right corner is a_8. From the text rule, each border entry equals the sum of its two edge-neighboring border entries, so a_i = a_{i-1} + a_{i+1}, equivalently a_{i+1} = a_i - a_{i-1}. Starting with a_0=A and a_1=B, this recurrence has period 6: A, B, B-A, -A, -B, A-B, then repeats. Since a_0=3 and a_13 has the same residue as a_1 mod 6, B=10. Then a_8 has the same residue as a_2 mod 6, so x=a_8=B-A=10-3=7.
